title: 毎日王冠の後に・猛追の代償

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa exhausts everything she's got to beat Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So much so, in fact, that she passes out from pushing herself beyond her limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One thing has become painfully clear to El Condor Pasa—if there are racers like Silence Suzuka at the Japan Cup, she doesn't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hangs her head dejectedly as she decides to give up on her goal of winning the Japan Cup in her classic year.
